title: Navigation Agents resuming from pause consume a noticeable amount of extra processing
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in all 4.6x and 4.7x.

Haven't tried lower versions.



### System information

Windows 10 - Godot v4.6.3.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDEA GeForce GTX 3060

### Issue description

When the SceneTree gets paused and unpaused, the navigation agents break and causes massive CPU leak.

Workaround set the NavigationAgent2D's to process_mode = Always

### Steps to reproduce

You can reproduce this with any amount of agents but you can really see it in action with a higher amount.
Create an Empty Node2D Scene(Main), add a NavigationRegion2D to it.
Create a script and attach it to the Main, inside it add
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(10.0).timeout
	get_tree().set_pause(true)
	await get_tree().create_timer(5.0).timeout
	get_tree().set_pause(false)
```
Setup the NavigationRegion2D so it covers 1280x720 pixels or more.

Create an Empty Node2D(Agent), add NavigationAgent2D to it.
Create a script and attach it to the Agent, inside it add
```gdscript

@export var movement_speed: float = 100.0
@onready var navigation_agent: NavigationAgent2D = get_node("NavigationAgent2D")
var movement_delta: float

func _ready() -> void:
	navigation_agent.velocity_computed.connect(Callable(_on_velocity_computed))

func set_movement_target(movement_target: Vector2):
	navigation_agent.set_target_position(Vector2(randf_range(0, 1280), randf_range(0, 720)))

func _physics_process(delta):
	# Do not query when the map has never synchronized and is empty.
	if NavigationServer2D.map_get_iteration_id(navigation_agent.get_navigation_map()) == 0:
		return
	if navigation_agent.is_navigation_finished():
		navigation_agent.set_target_position(Vector2(randf_range(0, 1280), randf_range(0, 720)))
		return

	movement_delta = movement_speed * delta
	var next_path_position: Vector2 = navigation_agent.get_next_path_position()
	var new_velocity: Vector2 = global_position.direction_to(next_path_position) * movement_delta
	if navigation_agent.avoidance_enabled:
		navigation_agent.set_velocity(new_velocity)
	else:
		_on_velocity_computed(new_velocity)

func _on_velocity_computed(safe_velocity: Vector2) -> void:
	global_position = global_position.move_toward(global_position + safe_velocity, movement_delta)
```

Duplicate the Agent inside the Main to 2,000 Agents.
Run the Main scene.
